deduplication: whitespace-normalized excerpt SHA256; sites, not independent mods or playtests
scope_limit: The 1000 status/immune/removal excerpts include static fireImmune registrations and provide only broad lifecycle context. Hash/line verification does not satisfy the armor window/owner/cooldown gate. The five follow-up ranges are partial reading, overlap whole methods, and do NOT close the 1000-site research gap.
timing_boundary: Existing fixes preceded satisfaction of the armor-specific gate. Later research must not be represented as completed before implementation.

armor_specific_followup.observation: Armor modifier is revoked when either its effect or equipment condition fails.
armor_specific_followup.application: Revoke temporary armor windows at threshold loss before they can be reactivated by re-equipping.

armor_specific_followup.observation: Amplifier transitions remove obsolete charged modifiers; absence removes charge benefits.
armor_specific_followup.application: Test threshold downgrades and temporary states separately from idempotent UUID refresh.

armor_specific_followup.observation: Weapon benefit reads both main hand and offhand and removes its modifier when the predicate fails.
armor_specific_followup.application: A paired-axe counter requires both original hands; Xuanwu counter source must not masquerade as an axe grant.

armor_specific_followup.observation: Player clone handling copies the player-owned cooldown capability.
armor_specific_followup.application: Retain persisted lastStand cooldown through gear changes and native player save/read; do not clear it with transient windows.

armor_specific_followup.observation: Movement state and airborne cooldown are checked on the actual player at the end of the tick.
armor_specific_followup.application: Read the current four-piece requirement at damage acceptance as well as removing stale stride state on equipment refresh.
